params._feedbackCooldown: Minimum seconds between feedback submissions per sender. 0 = no cooldown.

params.feedbackId: The feedback ID to look up.

returns.agentId: The agent that received the feedback.
returns.client: The address that submitted the feedback.
returns.revoked: Whether the feedback has been revoked.

getSummary(uint256,address[],string,stri.details: Filters by client addresses and tags. Pass empty arrays/strings      to skip filtering for that dimension. Use offset/limit for pagination      to avoid out-of-gas on agents with many feedback entries.

params.clients: Filter to only these client addresses. Empty = all clients.
params.limit: Maximum number of feedback entries to iterate over. 0 = no limit.
params.offset: The index in _agentFeedbackIds to start iterating from.
params.tag1: Filter by primary tag. Empty string = all tags.
params.tag2: Filter by secondary tag. Empty string = all tags.

returns.count: Number of matching non-revoked feedback entries in this page.
returns.decimals: The decimal precision (uses the first matching entry's decimals).
returns.nextOffset: The offset to pass for the next page, or 0 if no more entries.
returns.summaryValue: Sum of all matching feedback values in this page.

params.agentId: The agent's identity token ID from IdentityRegistry.
params.decimals: The decimal precision of value (e.g., 2 means value is scaled by 100).
params.endpoint: The specific service endpoint being reviewed.
params.feedbackHash: Keccak256 hash of the feedback content for integrity.
params.feedbackURI: URI pointing to detailed feedback JSON.
params.value: The feedback score. Positive = good, negative = bad.

revokeFeedback(uint256).details: Only the original feedback provider can revoke. Revoked feedback      is excluded from summary calculations.

params.feedbackId: The ID of the feedback to revoke.

feedbackCooldown().notice: Minimum seconds between feedback submissions per sender.

getSummary(uint256,address[],string,stri.notice: Get an aggregated reputation summary for an agent.

identityRegistry().notice: Reference to the IdentityRegistry for agent existence checks.

totalFeedback().notice: Get the total number of feedback entries submitted.
